audit.why: 50.54% over 1286 games with a Skill-flat early chart matches the written 'even, skill-based lane' framing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers and with the packet: win[4]/win[5] and phases[4..5].side said Locke while whys[4]/whys[5] both said even, and win[6]/phases[6].side said Skill while whys[6] says the stage favours Gangplank.
audit.why: packet.levelChart = [Skill x6, Gangplank]. The mirror audit (gangplank__locke) was already brought onto that chart, so leaving these rows would put the two directions in direct conflict.
audit.corrected: Rows 5, 6 and 7 set to Skill/Skill/Gangplank in both layers with matching ratings, as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two places claim Powder Keg knocks up ('chain two into a knockup', 'Chain barrels for AoE knockup'). Powder Keg does not displace — it spreads the attack's damage and slows.
audit.why: Riot text: 'If he attacks it, it explodes, spreading the attack's damage to enemies in the area, slowing them.' No knockup flag on the ability.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly tells you to commit 'on Powder Kegs' cooldown'. Powder Keg has no cooldown to track — it runs on stored charges, so there is no down-window to wait for.
audit.why: Kit lists Powder Keg cd 0, cost 0, range 1000.
audit.corrected: report[5] rewritten to the real tell: kill the keg, and step in after a detonation rather than before one.

audit.why: Remove Scurvy 'cures crowd control effects' — the existing claim that it cleanses your Q slow is right, and 22/20/18/16/14s makes it a real punish window.

edits.before: Chain barrels for AoE knockup and burst
edits.after: Chain barrels for AoE slow and burst

edits.before: Levels 1-5 are an even, skill-based lane. Your Q Ritual Nails and P Silver Stake missing-HP on-hit out-trade Gangplank's early Q Parrrley pokes, so pressure him whenever his barrels aren't set. The key skill test is his kegs — shoot or dodge the barrel before it detonates, and don't sit in a spot where he can chain two into a knockup during your walk-up.
edits.after: Levels 1-5 are an even, skill-based lane. Your Q Ritual Nails and P Silver Stake missing-HP on-hit out-trade Gangplank's early Q Parrrley pokes, so pressure him whenever his barrels aren't set. The key skill test is his kegs — kill or dodge the barrel before it detonates, and never stand where he can chain two of them to slow you through your walk-up.

edits.before: Track Gangplank’s Powder Kegs (Barrels): Barrel chains chunk half your HP — kill kegs on sight. Commit only while it is down.
edits.after: Track his kegs: Powder Keg has no cooldown, only stored charges — kill the keg on sight and step in after a detonation, never before one.

notes: Powder Keg knockup was fabricated in two places and is now removed. Also note the page tells you to engage 'on Powder Kegs' cooldown' in loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2], report[9] and breakdown.feeding — that advice is structurally wrong because the ability has no cooldown, but those strings are templated across every Locke matchup, so rewriting them one matchup at a time would desync the template. Flagged rather than half-fixed.
